title: Joshua's Conquest of Southern Canaan
description: After defeating the five Amorite kings, Joshua continues his military campaign in the south. He captures Makkedah, Libnah, Lachish (with the help of the king of Gezer who is defeated), Eglon, Hebron, and Debir. He strikes down these cities and their kings with devotion to destruction, from Kadesh-Barnea to Gaza, for the Lord fought for Israel. Finally, he returns to the camp at Gilgal [ref:Jos 10:28-43|Joshua 10:28-43].
